chunks: Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, revealed to Musa ibn 'Imran عليه السلام: 'Bring out the bones of Yusuf عليه السلام from Egypt,' and He promised him the rising of the moon. But the moon's rising was delayed for him, so he asked about someone who knew its location. It was said to him: 'Here is an old woman who knows about it.' So he sent for her, and an elderly woman, crippled and blind, was brought. He said, 'Do you know the grave of Yusuf عليه السلام?' She said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Then tell me its location.' She said, 'I will not do so until you give me certain things: free my legs, restore my sight to me, return my youth to me, and make me with you in Paradise.' That weighed heavily upon Musa, so Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to him: 'You are only giving on My behalf, so give her what she asked.' So he did, and she guided him to the grave of Yusuf عليه السلام. He brought him out from the bank of the Nile in a marble chest. Then when he brought him out, the moon rose, so he carried him to al-Sham. For that reason, the People of the Book carry their dead to al-Sham.

key_terms.أَوْحَى: revealed; denotes Allah's communication to Musa عليه السلام
key_terms.الشَّامِ: al-Sham; the destination to which Yusuf عليه السلام was carried
key_terms.النِّيلِ: the Nile; the riverbank where the grave was found
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise; the old woman asked to be with Musa عليه السلام there
key_terms.صُنْدُوقٍ: chest or coffin; the container from which Yusuf عليه السلام was extracted
key_terms.عَمْيَاءَ: blind; describing the old woman's lack of sight
key_terms.عِظَامَ: bones; the remains of Yusuf عليه السلام to be taken out of Egypt
key_terms.مُقْعَدَةٍ: crippled; describing the old woman's physical condition

ai.seo_question: Why did Musa ibn 'Imran عليه السلام carry the remains of Yusuf عليه السلام from Egypt to al-Sham?
ai.summary: This narration relates that Allah directed Musa ibn 'Imran عليه السلام to remove the remains of Yusuf عليه السلام from Egypt, and the matter was completed through an elderly woman who knew the grave's location. It highlights divine revelation, the granting of extraordinary favors by Allah, and the association of burial in al-Sham among the People of the Book with this event.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.594 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said :

Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, revealed to Musa ibn Imran (as) to bring out the bones of Yusuf (as) from Egypt ’, and promised him the rising of the moon.
However, the moon delayed in rising so he inquired about someone who knew its location. He was told of an elderly woman who knew its whereabouts.
He summoned her, and a paralyzed, blind elderly woman was brought before him.
Musa (as) asked: 'Do you know the grave of Yusuf (as)?'
She replied: 'Yes.'
Musa (as) said: 'Then inform me of its location.'
She said: 'I will not do so unless you grant me certain conditions: to restore my legs so that I may walk, to return my eyesight, to restore my youth, and to make me with you in Paradise.'
This request was burdensome for Musa (as), but Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, revealed to him,
'You are only granting these on My behalf, so fulfil her request.'
So Musa (as) did as She asked.
She then guided him to the grave of Yusuf (as), and Musa (as) extracted it from the banks of the Nile in a marble coffin. When he brought it out, the moon rose. He then carried it to Sham (the Levant).
For this reason, the People of the Book carry their dead to Sham."
